requirements.title: Install and maintain network security controls
requirements.description: Network security controls such as firewalls must be configured and maintained to protect the cardholder data environment from unauthorized network access.
requirements.section: Build and Maintain a Secure Network

requirements.title: Restrict connections between untrusted networks and the CDE
requirements.description: Configure firewall and router rules to restrict inbound and outbound traffic to that which is necessary for the cardholder data environment.
requirements.section: Build and Maintain a Secure Network

requirements.title: Apply secure configurations to all system components
requirements.description: Vendor-supplied defaults and unnecessary services must be changed or removed before deploying systems to production.
requirements.section: Build and Maintain a Secure Network

requirements.title: Protect stored account data
requirements.description: Stored cardholder data must be protected using encryption, truncation, masking, and hashing to render it unreadable.

requirements.title: Do not store sensitive authentication data after authorization
requirements.description: Sensitive authentication data including full track data, CAV2/CVC2/CVV2/CID and PINs must not be stored after authorization.

requirements.title: Protect cardholder data with strong cryptography during transmission
requirements.description: Use strong cryptography and security protocols to safeguard cardholder data during transmission over open, public networks.

requirements.title: Protect all systems and networks from malicious software
requirements.description: Deploy anti-malware solutions on all systems commonly affected by malicious software and ensure they are kept up to date.

requirements.title: Develop and maintain secure systems and software
requirements.description: Establish a process to identify and manage security vulnerabilities in custom and third-party software throughout the development lifecycle.

requirements.title: Restrict access to system components and cardholder data by business need to know
requirements.description: Limit access to cardholder data and system components to only those individuals whose jobs require such access.

requirements.title: Identify users and authenticate access to system components
requirements.description: Ensure proper user identification and authentication management for non-consumer users and administrators on all system components.

requirements.title: Restrict physical access to cardholder data
requirements.description: Use appropriate facility entry controls to limit and monitor physical access to systems in the cardholder data environment.

requirements.title: Log and monitor all access to system components and cardholder data
requirements.description: Implement logging mechanisms to track user activities, exceptions, faults, and information security events.

requirements.title: Test security of systems and networks regularly
requirements.description: Regularly test security systems and processes including vulnerability scans and penetration testing.

requirements.title: Support information security with organizational policies and programs
requirements.description: Establish, publish, maintain, and disseminate a security policy that addresses all PCI DSS requirements.
